text:
olivia: scanner flagged CVE-2026-GLIBC-FAKE in linux-base. Need rebuild + canary + attestations today.

sec-bot: created VULN-2026-GLIBC-FAKE severity=high affected=linux-base(all) action=rebuild+re-sign+SBOM+retain-logs

maria: pipeline will emit linux-base:2026-04-05-glibc-canary -> staging only for 90m. If green, promote to preprod overnight.

ton y: signing key is awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zk-sign-abc. Recommendation: for immediate canary, reuse key to avoid verifier churn; schedule rotation next week.

devops: ci-builder-sa lacks kms:Sign. I'll add kms:Sign/Verify/GetPublicKey scoped to the cosign key and bind role to namespace=ci.

akash: compliance: current audit bucket retention 90d; legal requires 1y for SBOMs and attestations. Need immutable retention (WORM). Also ensure CloudTrail captures KMS Sign calls.

sre-oncall: rollback plan: if canary fails, mark tag deprecated, pin clusters to linux-base:2026-02-20-stable, apply OPA admission to block new tag, and open incident. Alerts: 3x error rate sustained 10m.

maria: canary artifacts: sbom.json, cosign-attest.json, build.log -> s3://redwood-audit/cves/2026-GLIBC/ (set 1y retention). Tag images with label "canary-by=olivia" for fast revocation.

ton y: will update signing-runbook with verifier rollout steps: publish new public key to trust store, wait 12h, then rotate signing key. Document fallback verifying old sigs for 30d.

olivia: action items: devops add kms Sign perms (ETA 45m) @devops; maria trigger canary at 18:15 UTC and publish artifacts (ETA 18:00) @maria; tony validate audit ingestion of cosign events (ETA 30m) @tony; akash update compliance ticket and request legal hold (ETA EOD) @akash; sre-oncall prepare dashboard & standby (ETA start) @sre-oncall.

maria: adding a 10m startup-fuzz step to smoke to catch edge crashes.

olivia: enabling 24h branch protection on infra/base-images (require 2 approvals) and will freeze merges if we escalate. Ping here for permission issues. :lock: :thumbsup:
